crossRefs.note: Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.
“Brothers, it was necessary that this Scripture should be fulfilled, which the Holy Spirit spoke before by the mouth of…
him, being delivered up by the determined counsel and foreknowledge of God, you have taken by the hand of lawless men…
For there are certain men who crept in secretly, even those who were long ago written about for this condemnation…
Now Judas, who betrayed him, also knew the place, for Jesus often met there with his disciples.
Yes, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who ate bread with me, has lifted up his heel against me.
But it was you, a man like me, my companion, and my familiar friend.
We took sweet fellowship together. We walked in God’s house with company.
Then one of the twelve, who was called Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests,
Then Judas, who betrayed him, when he saw that Jesus was condemned, felt remorse, and brought back the thirty pieces of…

parallels.note: and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him. Then he came into a house.

people.name: Simon
people.line: Father of Judas Iscariot, the disciple who betrayed Jesus.

translations.web: Now he spoke of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, for it was he who would betray him, being one of the twelve.
translations.bsb: He was speaking about Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot. For although Judas was one of the Twelve, he was later to betray Jesus.
translations.kjv: He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon: for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.
translations.asv: Now he spake of Judas the son of Simon Iscariot, for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.
